title: Robinhood MCP with no LLM
author: CaseCapitalTrading
selftext:
I have built a LLM free trading terminal on a VPS and currently use alpaca for paper trading Im seeing astonishing gains and want to capitalize on that and  take it live I use robinhood as my personal investing account and would like to take my automated algo there too. can use robinhoods MCP with a non LLM terminal if so how?  
Help and suggestions are welcome!

comments.author: antoniusbethyname
comments.body:
Interesting I want to follow along here. If you have a coded system IBKR from what I understand can automatically execute but it will require occasional 2FA logins from what I have gathered. It’s not truly hands off for good. 

Other platforms like I think ninja trader or meta trader are what others use to actually automate a strategy. **Not sure though so take this all for a grain of salt.**

replies.author: CaseCapitalTrading
replies.body: So I have a IBKR account and have attempted to encode it and do the 2FA but since I’m running it on a VPS/in the cloud it disconnects when my laptop closes. Do you have a system that you’re using?

replies.author: antoniusbethyname
replies.body: No this is the main reason I haven’t built it out yet. I have a system I want to code to run on its own but it seems there aren’t many great options to run the system autonomously without potential interruptions like 2FA

comments.author: CaseCapitalTrading
comments.body: Yeah I think I might just have to run a LLM like Ollama on the VPS with it and just go through it like that ykm
